name: kxtrumpapprove
title: Trump's RCP approval average on Oct 15, 2026?
settlement: The market resolves based on the value in the "Approve" column of the "RCP Average" row of the table titled "President Trump Job Approval" on RealClearPolitics at exactly 1:00 PM ET on Oct 15, 2026. For the "Below 38.2%" market, Yes if that value is below 38.2%.
decideContext: Estimate how a news item shifts Trump's RealClearPolitics job approval average (Approve %) at 1:00 PM ET on Oct 15, 2026. The event has several bracket markets (below 38.2%, narrow 0.1-point buckets, and above), and the market resolves to the bracket containing the published RCP Approve value.
